title: SeatStateChanged
description: Published by Seat Inventory Service on every individual seat state transition. Derived from seat_async.yaml SeatStateChangedPayload. Consumed by: Notification (WebSocket push), Search (index update), Analytics (ClickHouse).

messageId.description: Consumer deduplication key (NFR-REL-002). Deduplicate on Redis SET NX messageId EX 3600.

eventId.description: Kafka partition key. All state changes for one event land on one partition — required for ordered real-time seat map (NFR-PERF-005).

transitionReason.description: Machine-readable reason. Enables Notification Service to select the correct WebSocket event type.

bookingId.description: Present for HOLD_CREATED and BOOKING_COMMITTED. Absent for HOLD_EXPIRED (Redis TTL — no application context), ADMIN_BLOCKED, ADMIN_UNBLOCKED.

customerId.description: Present for HOLD_CREATED and BOOKING_COMMITTED. Used by Notification Service to route WebSocket events to the correct userId room.

heldUntil.description: Present only when toState=HELD. Redis TTL expiry timestamp. Browser seat map shows held-until indicator for seats held by others.

SeatState.description: ADR-006 §3.9: AVAILABLE=Redis key absent; HELD=Redis key present TTL=600s; BOOKED=Redis key present no TTL; BLOCKED=PG only no Redis key.
